title: Jenn-Air — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Jenn-Air.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Bound by Nothing." Luxury tier. Jenn-Air is Whirlpool Corporations luxury brand — born from the invention of the downdraft range in 1961. The NOIR collection introduced a dark, industrial design language that stands apart from the stainless steel everything else. DualVertiFlow convection uses two fans with butterfly wings for superior air circulation. The WiFi-connected Culinary Center guides cooking with step-by-step recipes.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Design-forward luxury buyers who want something visually different from Sub-Zero/Wolf. Dark kitchen aesthetics. Connected luxury cooking.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Jenn-Air:

• NOIR design — the only luxury brand with a true dark aesthetic option

• DualVertiFlow convection with butterfly wing fans for the most even baking

• Culinary Center — built-in guided cooking with step-by-step recipes on the display

• Downdraft ventilation invented here — still the best integrated ventilation solution

• Whirlpool Corp backing means parts and service are easier than European brands
